Gita Rao: Quick kickoff for VitalBridge onboarding. Objective: pilot in 30 days, confirm success metrics and any early renewal risk. Who owns what? :wave:
Ethan Cole: I'll own API integration + keys rotation. Plan: smoke test by day 4 and share request/response examples.
Rasheda Khan: I'll run enablement and adoption playbook. Recommend 2 x 45m sessions (integrations; prompts & evals) and an ops runbook. Slots wk1 and wk2.
Diego Alvarez: Data & compliance owner here. Need sample payloads and DPA/SOC2. Flagging potential PHI fields 1 - will propose redaction + retention options.
Gita Rao: Sent intro and SOC2 request to their security lead. Will escalate if no reply in 48h.
Ethan Cole: Infra tip: start on a small Dedicated pool with batch size 6, prefix cache on. That should meet latency SLO while we iterate.
Rasheda Khan: Enablement checklist v1:
- Day 0: Stakeholder intros
- Day 2: API walkthrough
- Day 5: Prompt tuning + evals
- Day 12: Failover testing + runbook
- Day 30: Pilot review + renewal discussion
I'll add slide deck after session 1.
Diego Alvarez: Actionable risks: renewal-risk: medium (budget not finalized), exec sponsor: TBD. Data-risk: PHI possibility; will draft minimal-PII ingestion plan and KMS access notes (48h).
OnboardBot: "VitalBridge - Onboarding Kickoff" scheduled 2025-09-28 09:30 PDT (invite sent).
Gita Rao: Action items summary:
- Gita: exec intro + chase SOC2 (today)
- Ethan: smoke test + example payloads (day 4)
- Rasheda: enablement schedule + 10-case eval (wk1)
- Diego: redaction plan + KMS notes (48h)
If any blocker, drop here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
